title: Differentiable Causal Discovery for Singular Linear Models under Confounding
abstract: arXiv:2601.01368v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Score-based causal discovery in the presence of unobserved confounders requires both a consistent scoring criterion and an efficient search over graph structures. Linear causal models with correlated errors are naturally represented by acyclic directed mixed graphs (ADMGs), whose induced model families include singular statistical models for which the standard Bayesian Information Criterion is inconsistent. We develop a score-based framework for causal discovery over linear Gaussian ADMGs grounded in singular learning theory. We first verify that the conditions for consistency of the Widely Applicable Bayesian Information Criterion (WBIC) are satisfied by the linear causal model class. We then propose a scalable approximation of the WBIC via Automatic Differentiation Variational Inference (ADVI). Finally, we introduce a differentiable search over ADMGs through Gumbel-Softmax relaxations of both directed and bidirected adjacency. Expe

translated_title: 混杂因素下奇异线性模型的可微分因果发现
translated_abstract: 在存在未观测混杂因素的情况下，基于评分的因果发现方法既需要一致的评分准则，也需要在图结构上进行高效搜索。具有相关误差的线性因果模型自然地可以用有向无环混合图（ADMG）来表示，其诱导的模型族包含奇异统计模型，而对于这些奇异模型，标准的贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）是非一致的。我们基于奇异学习理论，开发了一个针对线性高斯ADMG的基于评分的因果发现框架。我们首先验证了线性因果模型类满足广泛适用贝叶斯信息准则（WBIC）一致性的条件。随后，我们通过自动微分变分推断（ADVI）提出了WBIC的一种可扩展近似方法。最后，我们通过对有向邻接和双向邻接进行Gumbel-Softmax松弛，引入了一种针对ADMG的可微分搜索方法。实验……
tldr: 该论文基于奇异学习理论提出了一个可微分因果发现框架，验证了WBIC在线性高斯ADMG奇异模型上的一致性，通过ADVI实现其可扩展近似，并利用Gumbel-Softmax松弛实现了在有向与双向邻接结构上的可微分搜索，从而在存在未观测混杂因素时实现高效的线性因果发现。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a differentiable causal discovery framework grounded in singular learning theory, which verifies WBIC consistency for linear Gaussian ADMGs with singular model families, approximates WBIC scalably via ADVI, and enables differentiable search over both directed and bidirected adjacency through Gumbel-Softmax relaxations for causal discovery under unobserved confounding.
